title: CoreWeave CEO确认与Nvidia合作稳定 尽管面临董事会调查
originalTitle: CoreWeave CEO sees stable Nvidia partnership despite board investigation
summary: CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator 在董事会调查期间确认与Nvidia合作稳定，强调2亿美元投资和AI工厂扩展的持续性。市场数据显示CoreWeave潜在破产概率下降，反映合作稳定性对其财务健康的影响。需关注Nvidia CEO涉事调查进展及CoreWeave后续战略披露。

story.title: CoreWeave confirms Nvidia partnership stability amid board investigation

author: Estefano Gomez
